text: Research loop: research, think through, research, think through
description: Open-ended work for an agent while training runs (needs no GPU, little memory): pick an open question of the art track (cheapest interesting rules, hallucination losses, CNN pyramids, CAs, particle bodies, world models at tiny scale), research it (papers, demos, code), think it through against this codebase and its costs, write the findings into the idea (status comment / new child ideas with hypotheses), pick the next question. Never finishes; each round leaves a written note.

status.comment: Round 1 (2026-11-24): NCA lower bounds and multi-scale: muNCA (68-few hundred params), DyNCA (multi-scale perception, style+flow losses), Cells-to-Pixels (coarse NCA + decoder). Written into Lower bounds, CNN pyramid, Train for hallucination; new idea: coarse net, fine decoder. Round 2: soft bodies (XPBD, shape matching) and Particle Life; found and fixed the unwelded triangle soup in swarm.rs (9e338fa); new idea: particle life between creatures. Round 3: DyNCA's style loss as train.style (random conv bank Grams) and an Optuna search (search.py), both committed 4d5417d.
